title: 13. Render HTML placeholders safely

examples.explanation: escape all five HTML special characters
inserted placeholders are not processed again

courseHelp.title: Course help
courseHelp.body:
Write your code in the function at the top of the editor. Follow the numbered steps and replace each TODO. Run checks the three examples. Submit checks all cases, including edge cases. Open the hints one at a time if you are stuck.

Keep the adapter class at the bottom unchanged. It reads the input, calls your function, and rejects changes to the input. Python 3.11 and the standard library.

hints: `html.escape(value)` escapes all five characters. It escapes quotes by default.
`match.group(0)` is the full placeholder text, such as `{{name}}`. `match.group(1)` is only the name.
Do not call `template.replace()` once for each name. A value that contains `{{b}}` would then be processed again. `re.sub` with a function makes one pass.
